rule: BookSync position sync (docs/design/position-sync.md §3): furthest wins; never push behind the server's place except an override or a released reread; a move is silent only before the page renders, else asked (Yes / No); No declines that one remote place.

inputs.local: L: this device's place, in local pages (Android: page; Xteink: a linear page ordinal)
inputs.server: R: the server's place mapped to local pages; null = the server has none
inputs.tolerance: same-place tolerance in the same units (default 1 page; percent-only: 2 %)
inputs.marker: M: this device's last sync of the book, {at: server timestamp, place}; null = none
inputs.turn_at: T_turn: this device's last page turn (s), 0 = none
inputs.reset: R is BookOrbit's reset (served as the start, dated now)
inputs.redated: R was only re-dated (onlyRedated: same chapter, at or before M)
inputs.finished: the book is finished (on the server or here)
inputs.released: the end-of-book hold is released (10 forward turns or Read again)
inputs.declined_at: server_at of the remote place the reader answered No to (0 = none)
inputs.override: a queued "Read from here everywhere", {at}; null = none
inputs.percent_only: R has no position (positionCompatible false or no xpointer)

decisions.same: both at one place: refresh M
decisions.follow: move back to R (a reset or an override elsewhere)
decisions.hold: keep L, no push, no move (finished book, end-of-book hold)
decisions.stay: keep L, no push, no move (the reader declined this remote place)
decisions.override: send L, skipping the behind-hold once
